input.brief: I run a small pottery shop. I need a new visual identity: a logo, a color palette, typography, and a short brand guide. I would like two initial logo concepts and two revision rounds. I will provide written business information and visual references. Website design and packaging design are outside this project. The final decision maker, deadline and budget have not been agreed yet.

scope.summary: A thoughtful pottery brand with a visual identity project initiated by a small pottery shop, focusing on logo, color palette, typography, and brand guide.

deliverables.title: Logo Concepts
deliverables.description: Two initial logo concepts provided in a detailed format.

deliverables.title: Color Palette
deliverables.description: A visual reference for color palette provided in a detailed format.

deliverables.title: Typography
deliverables.description: A visual reference for typography used in the brand guide.

deliverables.title: Brand Guide
deliverables.description: Written business information provided in a detailed format.

exclusions: Final decision maker, deadline, and budget
questions: What is the budget for the project?
Who will be responsible for the logo concepts?
What is the timeline for the logo concepts and revisions?

risks.title: Ambiguity in logo concepts
risks.detail: Potential ambiguity in the logo concepts may affect the final decision.
